content:
TYPE_COL <- "Stype"

#Sidebar dropdown filters
FILTER_DROPDOWNS <- c(cmajor = "cmajor",
                      bfirstgen = "first_gen",
                      Group1 = "Group1",
                      Group2 = "Group2")

filter_choices <- function(df, col) {
  v <- if (col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] else character(0)
  vals <- sort(unique(v[!is.na(v) & nzchar(v)]))
  labs <- vals
  labs[vals == "TRUE"] <- "Yes"
  labs[vals == "FALSE"] <- "No"
  c("All" = "All", setNames(vals, labs))
}

#Apply sidebar
apply_filters <- function(f, inp) {
  df <- f$kept
  active <- function(x) length(x) == 1 && !is.na(x) && nzchar(trimws(x)) && x != "All"
  col_of <- function(col) {
    if (!col %in% names(df)) return(rep("", nrow(df)))
    x <- df[[col]]
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    x
  }
  has_text <- function(col, x) grepl(tolower(trimws(x)), tolower(col_of(col)), fixed = TRUE)
  
  keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(df))
  if (active(inp$LN17)) keep <- keep & has_text("LN17", inp$LN17)
  if (active(inp$Advisor)) keep <- keep & has_text("Advisor", inp$Advisor)
  if (active(inp$bstudid)) keep <- keep & trimws(col_of("bstudidC2")) == trimws(inp$bstudid)
  if (active(inp$LN_init)) keep <- keep & toupper(substr(trimws(col_of("LN17")), 1, 1)) == inp$LN_init
  
  for (col in names(FILTER_DROPDOWNS)) {
    v <- inp[[FILTER_DROPDOWNS[[col]]]]
    if (active(v)) keep <- keep & col_of(col) == v
  }
  
  f$n_filtered_out <- sum(!keep)
  f$kept <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  f$n_kept <- sum(keep)
  f
}

TEMPLATES <- list(
  first_year = list(
    label = "First Year Advising Report",
    file = "typst/first_year_advising_report.typ",
    values = c("First-Year"),
    basename = "first_year_reports"
  ),
  transfer = list(
    label = "Transfer Advising Report",
    file = "typst/transfer_advising_report.typ",
    values = "Transfer/Older",
    basename = "transfer_reports"
  )
)

filter_by_type <- function(df, type_key) {
  keep <- df[[TYPE_COL]] %in% TEMPLATES[[type_key]]$values
  list(kept = df[keep, , drop = FALSE], n_total = nrow(df),
       n_kept = sum(keep), n_skipped = sum(!keep))
}

# Transliteration is done with explicit tables rather than
# iconv(x, to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT") because iconv's transliteration is
# supplied by the platform's iconv implementation, and webR (musl/emscripten)
# does not behave like desktop Windows R. Since production runs in webR, the
# mapping has to be ours. Escapes rather than literal characters so this file
# survives being read under any locale.

# Letters that expand to more than one ASCII character. These must run
# before chartr(), which is strictly one-to-one.
.TRANSLIT_MULTI <- c(
  "\u00df" = "ss",  # sharp s
  "\u00e6" = "ae",  # ae ligature
  "\u00c6" = "AE",  # AE ligature
  "\u0153" = "oe",  # oe ligature
  "\u0152" = "OE",  # OE ligature
  "\u00fe" = "th",  # thorn
  "\u00de" = "Th",  # Thorn
  "\u00f0" = "d",  # eth
  "\u00d0" = "D"  # Eth
)

#Letters that map one-to-one
.TRANSLIT_FROM <- paste0(
  "\u00c0\u00c1\u00c2\u00c3\u00c4\u00c5",  # A: grave acute circumflex tilde diaeresis ring
  "\u00c8\u00c9\u00ca\u00cb",  # E
  "\u00cc\u00cd\u00ce\u00cf",  # I
  "\u00d1",  # N tilde
  "\u00d2\u00d3\u00d4\u00d5\u00d6\u00d8",  # O, incl. O with stroke
  "\u00d9\u00da\u00db\u00dc",  # U
  "\u00dd",  # Y acute
  "\u00c7",  # C cedilla
  "\u00e0\u00e1\u00e2\u00e3\u00e4\u00e5",  # a
  "\u00e8\u00e9\u00ea\u00eb",  # e
  "\u00ec\u00ed\u00ee\u00ef",  # i
  "\u00f1",  # n tilde
  "\u00f2\u00f3\u00f4\u00f5\u00f6\u00f8",  # o, incl. o with stroke
  "\u00f9\u00fa\u00fb\u00fc",  # u
  "\u00fd\u00ff",  # y acute / diaeresis
  "\u00e7",  # c cedilla
  "\u0160\u0161\u017d\u017e\u0141\u0142"  # S/s caron, Z/z caron, L/l stroke
)
.TRANSLIT_TO <- paste0(
  "AAAAAA",
  "EEEE",
  "IIII",
  "N",
  "OOOOOO",
  "UUUU",
  "Y",
  "C",
  "aaaaaa",
  "eeee",
  "iiii",
  "n",
  "oooooo",
  "uuuu",
  "yy",
  "c",
  "SsZzLl"
)
stopifnot(nchar(.TRANSLIT_FROM) == nchar(.TRANSLIT_TO))

transliterate <- function(x) {
  for (i in seq_along(.TRANSLIT_MULTI)) {
    x <- gsub(names(.TRANSLIT_MULTI)[i], .TRANSLIT_MULTI[[i]], x, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  chartr(.TRANSLIT_FROM, .TRANSLIT_TO, x)
}

slug <- function(x) {
  x <- transliterate(x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", x)
  gsub("(^-|-$)", "", x)
}

#mode is "name" (FN17-LN17.pdf) or "id" (bstudidC2.pdf) 
#Names can collide, so de-duplicate
make_filenames <- function(df, mode = "name") {
  base <- if (identical(mode, "id")) {
    slug(df$bstudidC2)
  } else {
    slug(paste(df$FN17, df$LN17))
  }

  empty <- !nzchar(base)
  if (any(empty)) {
    fallback <- slug(df$bstudidC2[empty])
    fallback[!nzchar(fallback)] <- "report"
    base[empty] <- fallback
  }

  seen <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  vapply(base, function(b) {
    n <- (if (is.null(seen[[b]])) 0 else seen[[b]]) + 1
    assign(b, n, envir = seen)
    if (n == 1) paste0(b, ".pdf") else sprintf("%s-%d.pdf", b, n)
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}


#Builds the payload sent to JS via session$sendCustomMessage("compile_typst", ...)
build_compile_message <- function(kept, tpl, filename_mode = "name", root = ".") {
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(kept)), function(i) {
    lapply(as.list(kept[i, , drop = FALSE]), function(x) if (is.na(x)) "" else x)
  })

  list(
    sharedTemplate = paste(readLines(file.path(root, "typst/BCSSE_template.typ"), warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"),
    mainTemplate = paste(readLines(file.path(root, tpl$file), warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"),
    logo = {
      p <- file.path(root, "typst/BCSSE_clear_small.png")
      jsonlite::base64_enc(readBin(p, "raw", file.info(p)$size))
    },
    rows = as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(rows, auto_unbox = TRUE)),
    filenames = I(make_filenames(kept, filename_mode)),
    zipName = paste0(tpl$basename, ".zip")
  )
}

tally_message <- function(f, type_key) {
  label <- TEMPLATES[[type_key]]$label
  n_filt <- if (is.null(f$n_filtered_out)) 0 else f$n_filtered_out
  if (f$n_kept == 0 && n_filt > 0) {
    return(sprintf("No %s rows match the current filters (%d removed by filters).",
                   label, n_filt))
  }
  if (f$n_kept == 0) {
    other <- setdiff(names(TEMPLATES), type_key)[1]
    return(sprintf(
      "No rows match %s. This file has %d row(s) of another type - did you mean %s?",
      label, f$n_total, TEMPLATES[[other]]$label
    ))
  }
  msg <- sprintf("%d rows; %d match %s, %d skipped.",
                 f$n_total, f$n_kept, label, f$n_skipped)
  if (n_filt > 0) msg <- paste(msg, sprintf("%d more excluded by filters.", n_filt))
  msg
}

    ("cmakefr", "Making new friends"), 
    ("cintfac", "Interacting with faculty"),
  ),
)

#section(

    ("ccourdis", "Participate regularly in course discussions, even when you don't feel like it"),
    ("caskinst", "Ask instructors for help when you struggle wiht course assignments"),
    ("cfinish", "Finish something you have started when you encounter challenges"), 
    ("cstaypos", "Stay positive, even when you do poorly on a test or assignment"),
  ),
)

#section(
  "Academic Preparation",
  columns: (1.6fr, 1fr),
  prompt: "How prepared are you to:",
  scale: [1 = Not at all prepared \ to 6 = Very prepared],
  row:row,
  items: (
    ("cSGwrite", "Write clearly and effectively"), 
    ("cSGspeak", "Speak clearly and effectively"), 
    ("cSGthink", "Think critically and analytically"),
    ("cSGanalyze", "Analyze math or quantitative problems"),
    ("cgncompt13", "Use computing and information technology"),
    ("cSGothers", "Work effectively with others"),
    ("cgninq", "Learn effectively on your own"),
  ),
)
]
)
